nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Clearly Corrective Brightening Exfoliating Daily Cleanser

avis.texte: This has become my new favorite. It mixes a scrub with a cleansing wash. Not drying. Feels good. Smells fresh and clean. Good cost point.

I'm an Esthetician and absolutely love this. In between more invasive exfoliation, this is my go to!! Keeps my skin soft and clear ! Without causing trauma to my freshly exfoliated skin ! I have all of my clients hooked on everything kiehl's!

avis.titre: Love the smooth skin after using this product.
avis.texte: I use this gentle exfoliating cleanser every day. It leaves my face so smooth and clean feeling. Really like being able to use it every day.

It all started with a free sample. This cleanser has a subtle fresh smell with small, minimal exfoliation beads that feels so good on my face. It sloughs off the dry flakes of skin while being gentle on my sensitive skin.

It's a good cleanser but the pearls/grains get in the eyes and cause extreme discomfort. Even if it's not applied directly around eyes, it still get in eyes while washing face. The pearls are very sticky and don't come off after eyes are washed multiple times (they get stuck inside the eye lid). The formula is transparent/opaque so its hard to see if any of the particles remain in face or get in the eyes. Can Kiehl's explore water soluble grains so they don't cause extreme irritation in eyes?

Love it! You need the smallest amount. Like a pea size.. add water and it's magic. Foamy, and soft but scrubs away dry skin. Leaves my skin feeling so fresh and not dry. Try it. Use it everyday. It really is amazing!

avis.titre: Exactly What I Need for Gentle Resurfacing
avis.texte: I needed something a little more than just gentle cleansing. This product is formulated for everyday gentle cleansing and exfoliating. I expected the product to be grittier, but I am pleased with the results achieved without the coarseness I'm used to. It left my skin noticeably soft and smoother in appearance—a great start to moisturizing and make-up.
I love this product! Please don't ever discontinue this cleanser. It's the only thing that works for me!
please restock!!!! this is the best cleanser it actually clears up my acne! ill be soo sad if they discontinue this like they did with all my other favorite products :(

avis.titre: It really works brightening my skin!
avis.texte: This is my new facial cleaning routine now. Really amazed to see the effect each time I use it. It cleans and brightens my skin. It does require extensive rinsing before you open your eyes so that it does not get into your eyes. But totally worth the effort .

avis.titre: My Favorite Part of My Routine!
avis.texte: I love this product! It really solves my combination (mostly on the dry side) skin issues. Using this right out of the shower is ideal. My T-zone gets cleansed, the dead, drier skin is exfoliated away, and my face feels so renewed. Even though a little goes a long way, like most Kiehl's products, I make sure i have plenty of this in my travel bag. At the time of this review, they are currently out of stock. I am hoping this does make a return soon! Also, yes the the cap is really hard to open. And if there is some of the product dried under the cap, it can be even harder. I will use exfoliating glove for extra grip and make sure the area under the cap is clean after each (ok, most) uses. It's the only downside, but it doesn't take a star away in my opinion. The product inside is what I care about!
Leaves my face feeling clean and fresh. Definitely exfoliates really good.

avis.titre: Love this cleanser scrub - HATE th cap- total fail
avis.texte: I Love the product but I'm really aggravated too about the top cap snapping off completely, it's all gummy and it's all messed up. Obviously I can't use it for travel. Please do better with dispensing this daily cleanser scrub!!!!!' IT DESERVES BETTER
Exfoliates and cleans very well! And I do feel like it brightens my skin! I really like it. Except it is a little gummy/ sticky and burns the inside of my nose even if none of it makes contact there.
I love this daily cleanser. It's gentle exfoliation for everyday and really gets my face clean. I'm very happy with this product and will definitely buy it again.

avis.titre: Great light scrub and face wash
avis.texte: I really like this product due to its light scrub qualities and good cleansing ability. It is my go to am face wash. Can't say much about it's brightening properties as I use other products for that as well but it is a good solid cleanser.
Gentle cleansing and gentle exfoliation. Keep returning to this product.

I am really liking this product. It actually is brightening and evening out my complexion, doing what it promises. Very gentle. My skin is very sensitive, so I'm only using it 2-3 times a week rather than everyday, and I do notice a difference. I follow up with the newly formulated overnight moisture mask which I really like too.
The bottle top was broken so difficult to use the product and can't travel with it.

This is my second time purchasing this face wash and I LOVE it. It was always my go to after working nights for 5 years because it gave my skin a much needed glow up with the added benefit of super smooth skin. After having another baby last year I started getting some freckles on my cheeks and nose and this wash helps brighten those spots of hyperpigmentation. The best part is that you need very little of this wash because it goes a long way so this bottle will last you at least 3 months. I would definitely recommend!
I use this product and the Vit C serum, the avacado eye cream and the daily SPF Day Cream and these products have changed my skin ! At age 66 !

avis.titre: Amazing for Weekly use for Dry Skin
avis.texte: I love this product and i have been using for years and I have dry and sensitive skins so I use it weekly. It instantly makes my skin feel free of impurities and small pimples + brightens amazingly. My boyfriend uses it everyday at night for his very oily skin during the summer and every other day in the winter. His skin is literally pimple free, which was a problem for him in the past. For both, of course makes sense to follow with a good moisturizer, and a serum for me as well. HIGHLY RECOMMEND.
Love this product. Has become apart of my skincare routine. Always have to have. When I moved to a more humid state my skin did not react well but Kiehls literally saved my skin.

It's still a Gentle cleanser and I love the exfoliation factor. I've been using the "gentle cleanser" for years and going a scrub/ exfoliant separate. I just swap this in a few times a week and my skin feels smooth moisturized and bright

I really like it. The best exfoliating cleanser I've ever used. Everyone's skin is different, so many times I've gotten a product that is very popular and it just doesn't work out for me. This one I always come back to it.
Ever since trying this nothing is the same, the quality of this is unmatched!

Over the years, I have tried probably every exfoliator on the market - well, all the expensive ones at least LOL - and this wins hands down for 1. Gentle enough yet scrubby enough, 2. Efficient makeup removal (not eye), 3. No residue, 4. Can easily use every day without overly drying my skin. Now, if they would put it in a JAR, it would be perfection!

I've tried dozens and dozens (and dozens) of facial cleansers for my picky skin. I'm very acne prone at 29-years-old. Most cleansers are too mild and cause breakouts or completely strip/dry out my face. Enter: this cleanser. I was actually shocked at how soft my face feels. I do notice more even skin tone too, but honestly still just getting over the shock of of how clean and soft I'm left feeling. It's wild to me. I could see this being too abrasive for sensitive skin as it's a physical exfoliate, but for me this cleanser earned a loyalist.
Favorite cleanser ever! Smells so good, starts off as an exfoliant and then gets foamy.
I don't know why this is not promoted more! Wonderfully gentle exfoliate. I received several compliments on my skin after a week of regular use.
I have sensitive skin and was a little worried about trying a new cleanser, however, I am so glad i did. My skin has a shiny glow. I am very happy with this product.
This product was not what I expected or an Exfoliating Daily Cleanser.
Leaves skin bright and glowing. One of my favorite cleansers and great price and brand.
Love the cleanser. Very pleasant on the skin, not greasy or too ruff. Very light scent which me personally i love it

Only a small amount is needed. It comes out clear, however when you begin to rub it on your face, it immediately begins to lather! It left my face feeling extremely clean & refreshed! I never had a face wash make my skin feel so clean!😃.

Have been using this product for a few years and I am satisfied with the progress I see with my skin. I will continue to purchase it since it has cleared away some dark spots and makes my skin look overall brighter and fresh.

avis.titre: You will love it! Such a clean feeling!
avis.texte: I've used this product for as long as I have been able to afford good facial products. I'm almost 40 so about 15 years or so and I absolutely love it! If I don't have it and have to use something else to cleanse my face, I just don't feel like my face is actually clean. My teen daughter also started using it a few years ago and it has helped so much with her teen breakouts. Yes, I was a little worried when the change happened (no longer using plastic beads in it for exfoliation) but Kiehls did what was best for the environment and quite honestly us too as it's much better for our skin to use a natural exfoliant. I still really love this product and you will too!
This is the only cleanser I will use for the rest of my life. I always get compliments on my skin and this is my holy grail.
Helps maintain my skin pimple free especially from working in the hospital with face mask all the time

This is gentle enough to use daily. My skin feels clean after using. Biggest drawback for me is the packaging. The thicker consistency tends to leave a residue build up in the cap, and over time it just became a real mess.

Very good exfoliating scrub. Good for daily use and the only face wash I've used that actually helps with keratosis pilaris. Revealed fresher, brighter skin after only a few weeks. Also lasts a long time. Would recommend.
I love this cleanser! It's perfect for daily use. I keep mine inside of my shower, and use alongside the cleanser. Love the scent, and the way it exfoliates without over drying my skin.

The best facial cleanser I've ever tried (and I've tried a lot!) - my skin felt noticeably smoother and I swear brighter after the very first use! I also like that you only have to use a small amount (about the size of 2 peas!) to get a good cleanse, even when removing makeup.
This product works just like Kiehl's said it would. That's all you need to know.
This daily exfoliating scrub really works it leaves your skin feeling and looking clean and bright without drying.
The perfect daily cleanser. Great exfoliating without scrubbing my skin completely away. Have been using this for years. Just love it.
I truly enjoy this face wash I like the feel of the exfoliation beads and in the end my face feel clean and ready to absorb my toner, serum and moisturizer. Simply awesome
I've been using it for at least a year and continually repurchase. It cleans and exfoliates beautifully without leaving your skin dry or tight.
Exactly what I needed for my skin routine. Would definitely recommend this product.
I absolutely love how well this cleanses but isn't rough on my facial skin.
This stuff lathers up like a dream. A little bit goes a long way. I can't believe how long it has lasted me! Buying it again because I found the perfect cleanser for my skin!

I've been looking for a new cleanser. The Sircuit Xtrap I've loved for a long time just wasn't doing it for me any more. Not sure why. But this is GREAT. Love the light scrub, the smell, and the tiny bit you need for a luxurious lather.

My complexion has never looked better. I have tried so many washes and exfoliating products over the years and this has yielded the best results. I never have breakouts anymore also. I if I feel a flare up coming, I just stick with my routine using this every evening when I wash my face and it keeps blemishes away. Thank you Kiehls for making this highly effective cleanser! My skin just looks cleaner- and to the title of the product - brighter~~

I had an extremely stubborn blackhead on my upper lip. I tried EVERYTHING to remove it. It was there for months and resisted all cleansers and attempts to squeeze it out. ONE use of this product removed it. I'm thrilled. This is my face wash for life.

After using this product for a week my skin feels so soft and clear. I love the combination of an exfoliatior blended with a gentle face cleanser. This product in particular is very heavy in texture therefore, all you need is a pea size. The pea size can wash my whole face and neck area. Lastly, it has a nice pleasant scent!

avis.titre: Hate the messy lid - love product
avis.texte: I use the product a few times a week, and love the results. I wish they would use different packaging - the lid allows product to build up around opening, which both wastes product and looks disgusting. It's impossible to dispense product without leaving a bit in the lid indentation, if the hole in the lid was inverted this issue would be lessened. I live in the mountains and in the winter the air is VERY dry, after washing my face with this my skin feels refreshed, clean and soft.

avis.titre: This Product Helped With My Pimples
avis.texte: After using this product for 2/3 weeks, I saw a difference on my face. Especially with wearing a mask, I went from having just a few pimples to many. When using this product, my face has become noticeably clearer (still a work in progress).

avis.titre: The Best Cleanser for Combo/Oily/Congested Skin
avis.texte: Ok people...I've honestly never tried the original formula mentioned in other reviews, but this stuff is amazing! I'm 50 and I have struggled with oily T-zone, acne/cystic acne for years and finally have clear skin! I've tried every cleanser (admitted skin care addiction) and while I thought I found results with other cleansers, it would only be temporary. My 20 year old daughter swears by it! Her skin has cleared and she is able to go foundation free with flawless skin. We've been using for over two years. It has pearlstone that acts as a gentle scrub unclogging pores, leaving your skin soft and smooth. Although its a little pricey, a dime/nickel size amount will clean your entire face and neck, so a tube lasts about 3-4 mos. Love this product!
I've been using this for two years and nothing makes my face feel as fresh and clean. I see a noticeable difference in the texture and appearance of my skin, including a lightening of dark spots!

avis.titre: Love the scrub and and the clean!
avis.texte: I really like the light lather and perfect texture of this cleanser. Works well on my skin - brightens and refines.

avis.titre: This is the best Cleanser I have ever had
avis.texte: I dont understand the bad reviews of this product. It is amazing. it removes all my makeup with one time use at night after work. i have to use just a little bit of it and it exfoliates my skin and create a soft foam while cleaning. it is perfect, i dont have to remove my makeup with any paper or cotton that will make me stretch my skin, this is one time in the shower and done. perfection.
This makes my skin feel amazing! I received this in my Ipsy bag and will be purchasing the bigger size!

Reading the other reviews I was surprised to hear that individuals did not have a good experience with the product--I do not write reviews often and felt it necessary to write one after reading the others. I must admit I was not privy to the previous version of the product. However, absolutely love this version. I had a breakout of acne a year ago and started using this product. My acne soon became minimal. Additionally, a little of this product goes a long way and lasts for at least 6 months. I highly recommend it! My skin has not looked better.

avis.titre: Nothing like the original, such a disappointment
avis.texte: The original product of the clearly corrective facial wash was amazing. I do not understand why it was ever changed I used it for years. Then I bought this product whenever it came out and it was awful I felt so scratchy against my skin. I went back to try it again and it is still terrible. Bring back the original formula. There was nothing wrong with it.

I love this stuff! I have read the reviews about how it's different from the previous formula however I never used it being it was my first time to use it. I don't have anything to compare it to so I absolutely love it! My skin has never looked better!!! About to reorder!

avis.titre: A little goes a long way!
avis.texte: Best daily face wash I've used. Works great for my skin year round even with the changing seasons in the Midwest. A tube lasts me 6 months using it once a day so the value is there for me. Would be lost without it!
Have been using this since november 2019, I am in love with it. It always leaves my face feeling so clean and refreshed.

I change cleansers all the time because we get bored but this one I keep going back to for my morning routine. I love the combination of exfoliating beads and foaming cleanser. It gives a great foundation for moisturizers and foundation. A must have!

I've been looking for something to clear my face , dark spots n even the tone and thus worked wonderfully and when I'm out I can definitely see the difference . I love it . After a few weeks you will notice your face is much cleaner and clearer

it's been a while now since they changed to a new formula. I'm still upset. Before it was white birch and peony and now its white birch and pearlstone. My face doesn't feel clean the way it used to. I accidentally bought the new formula and was very disappointed. I hope they'll reconsider bringing back the original formula and product.

avis.titre: the cleanser i have been looking for
avis.texte: i love this product. i have small bumps and dead skin in many parts of my face. this cleanser is not overly stripping and leaves my skin soft, overnight those dry spots and bumps faded!

I'm so confused with all of these bad reviews. I've always been the person to switch up my cleansers but I just keep buying this. I love the texture, a dime size goes along way, and the smell is amazing. My face always feel smooth and tightened after using. I love love love.
The beads are teeny tiny and don't break blood vessels. My skin is smooth and ready to accept the test of my Kiehls's routine. I use it only at night. I love this stuff. I'm 62 yo and my skin glows.
I used to love this cleanser - but the new formula is not that great, kind of feels like glue coming out of the tube and leaves my face feeling dry. Please bring back the old formula!!

The formula is smooth with a great, more abrasive exfoliator. I like that a pea-sized amount is enough to exfoliate and cleanse my face, neck and chest. I've purchased this 3 times and would give this product 5 stars if it wasn't for the faulty packaging. IF YOU DROP THIS, IT WILL BREAK. The cap has shattered on me all three times after falling off the bathroom sink or after being dropped in the shower. Given the high price point, I expect more durable packaging.

Can you see per the reviews? It was perfect and once you changed it, we don?t like it. So change it back! The old formula was literally the best cleanser i?d ever used in my life. Someone needs to copy the old formula and release an amazing cleanser lol

avis.titre: it's the face cleaner i've been looking for.
avis.texte: i never tried the prior formulation, so i can't compare. but for me, this is perhaps my perfect face cleanser. it foams just the right amount. has just the right amount of exfoliating ingredients so that it feels properly cleansed but not overly so. my skin always looks bright and fresh after i use it. and, as someone who is 48, with aging skin, who has hit perimenopause, it has helped immensely with my dry skin. it was getting to the point where i was having so much dead skin on my cheeks and chin that if i rubbed my face, skin would come off on my fingers. no more since using this product. and my skin looks less dull and ragged.
I love this stuff. I use it once daily. It's the perfect amount of scrubby for daily use. A little goes a long way, which I also love.
While this new formula does get my skin squeaky clean, I miss the ?scrubbiness? of the old one. There is very little exfoliating material in this one.

I went to my local store and informed the rep that I was looking for a new cleanser. She recommended this one. I've liked her recommendations in the past so without looking at the packaging too much I decided to give it a try. It's a physical exfoliant. ALMOST ALL skincare professionals who are truly educated will advise against a physical exfoliant. Especially for someone who suffers from hyperpigmentation like myself. Physical exfoliants cause microtears in the skin likely to aid in the production of more skin discoloration. So the fact that Kiehl's, a skincare company so highly regarded, has employees promoting this product shocked me. While I understand why it's in their product armory, people like why they like regardless of science so make the product for them so they don't go elsewhere—don't encourage its usage. It damages skin.
Have had SOO many compliments on my skin since using this product. Really happy with this face wash and will certainly be repurchasing.
This cleanser feels amazing when you apply it, my face loves! it I love the texture and how you can seriously use one drop and it goes a long way!

The Clearly Corrective Treatment Water is such a disappointment, I have used the Clearly Corrective Clarity-Activating Toner for many years. Kiehl's, why so many formulation changes …Such as the Clearly Corrective Exfoliator? Micro-Blur Skin Perfector? I have been a loyal Kiehl's user for 10+ years, with all these changes, I've switched half my skin care line to another brand.
I added this face wash recently to my daily Kiehl's skincare routine and after a couple uses I couldn't believe how smooth my skin felt! What a difference this product has made.
Amazing product, I'm a aesthetician and this is the very few brands that I love using on myself and clients. This cleanser really works and paired with the serum it works wonders! I love it!

I am surprised to see so many negative reviews for this cleanser because I love it and it has had wonderful effects on my skin. It seems like most of the negative reviews are coming from those who used a previous product that has been discontinued and are disappointed that this product is not comparable, rather than looking at it as a new and different product. This cleanser makes my skin look and feel visibly smoother and softer. I have milia-prone skin, and i this exfoliator is helping to prevent new milia from forming - my skin has not looked this good in quite some time! Will continue to use.

Like others, I was unpleasantly surprised to find that this is NOT the same product as the Clearly Corrective Brightening Exfoliator they used to carry (although the packaging is so close, which is why i didn't notice this was a "daily cleanser" and not an "exfoliator"). The old product was amazing, after one use you could feel the dead skin slough off and the results were noticeable. I loved that it was a chemical exfoliant so that you didn't have to scrub hard or at all to still get the benefits. This is just a gel cleanser with exfoliating beads in it. Super bummed.

So, I can?t compare this to the cleanser that others have referenced that was discontinued from this line. I also received this as a sample. Personally, it?s done good things for my skin. I?ve noticed a brighter complexion and some reduction in dark spots (I was also using a sample of their dark spot serum, so that could be helping as well). I?ve also used it daily and I find that it exfoliates without irritating my skin, and I?m usually very sensitive to that. The sample is enough for me to pull the trigger on a full size, but I think one thing is clear: if you can try before you buy, do it.

avis.titre: This product blows away my previous cleanser!
avis.texte: I feel so bad for the folks who had great experiences with the prior product. I?m fairly new to the Kiehl?s product line, but I have to say that I absolutely love this product! My skin is very sensitive, so I?ve shelled out a lot of cash over the years trying various products, and the product I used (most recently) before this one cost more than twice as much and didn?t work half as well. Not only does this product clean my skin without creating a red, splotchy face, but it really does brighten my skin...to the point where I bumped into some old friends who told me that I look much younger! Needless to say, I?m a huge fan of this cleanser! To those of you who may not be as enamored, hang in there and keep trying some other Kiehl?s options!

I just can?t...is it not beyond obvious that this was a terrible idea by now, just look at the reviews. I also USED to be a fan of Kiehls, and spent very good money on the CC Foam cleanser as well(as majority of commenters). Discontinuing without warning is just disrespectful to loyal customers as myself for the past 7-8yrs. I have invested in you and my skin and am disappointed that now I must find something new. Please continue to s/w the senior management in the company about the disappointment many many customers feel.

The Clearly Corrective Brightening collection used to have a product called *Skin Brightening Exfoliator.* When I purchased from a retail location, I thought maybe they just changed the name to *Brightening & Exfoliating Daily Cleanser.* Sadly, no. The formula has also changed, and the texture of the product makes it impossible to squeeze out of the bottle without making a mess (think gooey, melted cheese). And forget rubbing your fingertips together to apply to your face! When I thew it away, I squeezed it out of the bottle so I could at least recycle the bottle... only to have the mess sit like a wad on top of my drain and clog it. Too bad because the previous formula was great... in the month or so since I was forced to switch to a different brand, my skin clarity has obviously suffered and the red splotchiness on my face is back.

I thought the bad reviews were maybe not true and decided to try the new one out but i was extremely disappointed. After religiously using the old one i thought they couldnt have replaced the old one with something worse but they did. This new cleanser does nothing for my skin. I might as well not even wash it it really does NOTHING for my skin. The old one was amazing so clean and refreshing and made my skin look so bright. I miss it so much. I have never felt this way about a product so i am just so sad. I hope the old one comes back PLEASE. dont waste your money on the new one. take my advice!

I am a flight attendant and the purifying face wash was the only one that suited my ever sensitive dehydrated skin I recommended it to all of my colleagues, my skin was so much nicer and dewy no breakouts just a radiant complexion I still have the old face wash, using it very sparsely now because I know there will never be another one in the future!! I used to go to every duty free in Australia to always pick one up and always ended up walking out with a bag full of new products to try. Since its been discontinued I don't even want to look in the shop direction anymore. Very disheartened if I knew before I'd have stocked up on them. Kiehls you've lost your most excited customer. :( :( :( :( :( :(
I have very sensitive skin so I have to be careful. I miss the old cleanser because I was used to it. But so far this one makes my skin happy, and clear.
I?m a huge fan of this product. I use it on my face and neck three times a week and my skin glows! Highly recommend!

I've never known an exfoliator I could use every day without my skin suffering dryness or irritation. This one is A-OK with my face! And in the 6 months since I've been using this, I've had significantly fewer breakouts.

avis.titre: Bring back the Clearly Corrective Foaming Cleanser
avis.texte: So disappointed with this product. It doesn't foam up like the discontinued product and I find, due to the exfoliating beads I can't use it daily. I had been buying the foaming cleanser for a long time and was very happy with it. Not sure why the product was discontinued.

I have used the purifying cleanser for years and tried this an alternative and it is just not as good as the purifying cleanser. Very sad that Kiehls has discontinued my cleanser and not sure if I will replace with a new one from this company.

For all daily exfoliating cleanser I've purchased from before, it's always too harsh and always drying out my skin. This one would not!! So gentle yet exfoliate just enough leaving my skin clean, soft and refreshing. Love it!
I use this product every evening. It is absolutely the best product to remove heavy mineral based sunblock and other pollutants. It helps maintain my pore size and truly does brighten!

I usually don?t write reviews but I was compelled to express how much I absolutely dislike this product. I don?t get the same results with this daily exfoliater as I did with the purifying cleanser. Why did you discontinue the purifying cleanser!?!??? Now I must find a new brand.. thanks a lot Kiehls. I?ve been a loyal customer for the past 6 years.

avis.titre: I do not like this, I am LOST.
avis.texte: I did not realize that I purchased a different product from what I thought I was purchasing until I opened it and used it first time. This new product is utterly terrible. Now I do not know how to cleanse my oily skin. I am so stressed out that I need to start a new endeavor to find out the perfect exfoliator for my skin. I had been so happy with your previous product for so long, and now I am LOST. I would be so happy if you could bring back your previous exfoliator ASAP.

I love this cleanser. I was originally upset when they discontinued the foaming cleanser, but after trying the samples I fell in love. My skin needs exfoliation every day and can handle it, so this is the perfect product for me. My face has never been more clear. If you?re looking for a cleanser and your skin needs daily exfoliation and/or you have acne it may work. Request a sample!

I?ve been using Kiehls religiously for over 8-9 years. My favorite product was the brightening exfoliator and I was so sad when they decided to keep changing the formulas!! This new product is horrible and so ineffective. Unfortunately, I had to stop buying as much from them. Hopefully one day the Clearly Corrective brightening exfoliator will make a comeback!

Why would you discontinue the Foaming Face wash that I absolutely loved? Any apparently many others did, too? You just lost a loyal customer! I do not like your replacement, as who needs exfoliating every single day?? PLEASE bring back the old one!!

Why would u do this the old formulae was perfect!!!! I finally found something that worked really well for my oily acne prone skin and it was discontinued without warning. So sad I'll need to look for something else. PLEASE BRING BACK THE OLD FORMULA!!

I swear this product helps with my acne! I started getting cystic acne in my early 20?s and tried all kinds of different cleansers. Some worked for a little bit but most of them left me feeling dry, my acne returned and my texture was awful. I swear this cleanser has helped me with my acne and has slowly been brightening my mild acne marks. The biggest thing I?ve noticed and even my family/friends is the texture of my skin! It?s less stressed, red and more smooth in a sense. It has tiny exfoliants in it but it?s gentle enough to use twice a day. I bought this in January and it?s lasted me until May so it lasts a long time! Highly worth trying!! Please don?t discontinue this!

So disappointed that the old foaming cleanser is gone. My skin does not like to be exfoliated every day and my skin looks worse and feels dull. I used to love washing my face with the old foaming cleanser. Please consider bringing it back. I wont be purchasing this one again and the other cleanser is also filmy. So so so disappointed.

Just when you find something that works perfectly, you find out it is discontinued and with no warning! No way I will be able to use this so called new formula as my skin cannot take daily exfoliation! Sad that I need to search for a new brand that works better than this new formula and as good as the old one. Why do companies do this? If it ain't broke don't fix it!
Well there goes another great product due to someone's screw up .... Can I return this crap? You should WARN us!!!!

avis.titre: Please please bring back the old cleanser ASAP!
avis.texte: The original cleanser worked wonders and I was upset to find out it has been replaced. The new version is terrible- harsh on my sensitive skin. Why try to reinvent something that worked so well before??? It?s pretty obvious that this new formula is a bust from all the other negative reviews, so please do something NOW to save your loyal kiehls customers from jumping ship to another brand and BRING BACK THE ORIGINAL CLEANSER ALREADY PLEASE!!!

avis.titre: Bring back the old formula please
avis.texte: I love Kiehl's and have used this line for years but this is a total bust and I miss the old formula. The cap broke off on first use, and I can't dispense a small enough amount either based on the bottle design. And what is in it just is not a good formula. My skin doesn't feel clean and refreshed and that much exfoliant twice daily dries out my skin and it doesn't feel healthy like it used to. I also don't know whether exfoliating elements in it are environmentally friendly or if they are ocean killing microplastics. Please please please bring the old one back!!!!

avis.titre: Want the old formula back please !
avis.texte: This formula seems less textured and so less effective at exfoliating. I am disappointed and don't want to change my skin care just because I don't like the new scrub.

I am so disappointed that my favorite face wash that I have used for the past 5 years has been discontinued. I went into the store to pick up some face wash as I am running low only to find that it was not there. I tried the new formulation, but was not a fan. Please bring back the old formulation! I don?t care for any of the other Kiehl?s face washes so I will be looking for a new brand of face wash once I run out.
Please please please?! Why are you trying to fix something that wasn't broken?! So disappointed. Loved the old stuff- was devastated when i couldnt order more. Bring it back PLEASE!

I loved the foaming cleanser. Used it on a daily basis. I do not understand why you would mess with something so good. Very disappointed in Kiehls. I am a very loyal customer and you rarely/if ever change formulas. I am surprised.

avis.titre: Please bring back the old formula!!
avis.texte: Please, please bring back the old formula! I love Kiehl's and this was favorite face wash. The texture is completely different now and the product does not leave my face feeling as clean as the previous product did. It is also not as moisturizing as the old formula. My face feels extremely dry after using the new product.
